tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Praesago property area data for England and Wales by place name, borough, region or postcode district. Use it when you only have a place name (for example Hackney or Sheffield) and want the matching districts. Returns matching areas with ids and links; an empty list means no match.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Shows the credits left on your API key (free this month and purchased) and what you spent today and this month. It costs nothing. Needs an API key. Example: call it before a long batch to stay within budget.

tools.description: Fetch the Praesago area profile for a postcode district returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
